headline: A 2018 law renames a San Bernardino, California post office building after Jack H. Brown.
what_it_does: The law officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 390 West 5th Street in San Bernardino, California, the "Jack H. Brown Post Office Building." It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or how the building operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 6, 2018.
